data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that adds soft, blurred shadow effects to any child widget.
data.what_it_does: Shadex provides a simple drop-in widget that applies a customizable blurred shadow behind any child element. It supports adjusting the shadow color, blur radius, and offset, making it especially useful for SVGs and vector illustrations.
use_when: You want to add soft shadows to SVG icons or vector illustrations
You need a quick drop-in shadow effect without complex layer setups
avoid_when: You need complex multi-layer shadows or advanced clipping
You are using built-in widgets that already natively support the required shadow styling
strengths: Simple drop-in widget with no setup required
Highly customizable shadow color, blur, and offset
weaknesses: Very limited scope focusing solely on basic shadow effects

alternatives.name: shimmer
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need loading placeholder animations rather than static blurred shadows.
